rows.label: qst640101_msg0001
rows.name:
I've got an interesting story a Driver
might like, so I'll tell you.

rows.label: qst640101_msg0002
rows.name:
Rumor says a Divine Beast ship,
packed with boosters to the rafters,
sank on its way to Acedia.

rows.label: qst640101_msg0003
rows.name:
Apparently it sank near Lasqam Island
in Gula.

rows.label: qst640101_msg0004
rows.name:
A Salvager should be able to recover
them without much trouble, but...

rows.label: qst640101_msg0005
rows.name:
Apparently you need some special
equipment to collect the Boosters.

rows.label: qst640101_msg0006
rows.name:
I heard a Nopon named Sisoso in the
backstreets knows the details. Go ask.

rows.label: qst640101_msg0007
rows.name:
Don't mention it. I only told you
because I don't have the aptitude to
be a Driver.

rows.label: qst640101_msg0008
rows.name:
If I were a Driver, I wouldn't have
told you.
